items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: The interviewee discusses playing in 'Pirone's band' and mentions 'Celestan' only in the interviewer's question ('Celestan and Pirone's band, you played with them'). The interviewee does not mention Celestan by name or describe a specific interaction with him, only with Pirone's band.

ctx.x: Chris did have bad shoes. With that question, Doc, he sure did. Because when Faye saw that time, him and Black Banner had that humbug about tuxedo suits and all that. Chris was a man that's not like to drink, you know. He was a good blues man and didn't wear too much fancy clothes, you know. No, no. That's why we tell the people the truth.
But now, Celestan and Pirone's band, you played with them. Yeah, them guys were uniform. What were they dressed like?

Well, Pirone band, before I went in that group, they was, I think, now they're uniformed, I don't know if they were tuxedos when they were working at Tranchino. But when I went in the band, would have been 30, let me see, no, 28. They was wearing, we was wearing, you know, what you call like a gamel of striped pants, and sort of a pants, sort of a checkered coat like. Like pep and salt coat, with gamel of striped pants when we were working at Suburban Garden nightclub. And then a tuxedo band, well they always…
